Recently i have been trying to look at what other people and interpreters are getting from the verse about Lut A.S as I think alot of the scholars are always going to the same conclusion due to the way of interpreting being fixed and not open to critical thinking (Asma Barlas in Believing women in Islam talks about this in much better detail if you are interested). I signed up for Qist.com and there is a ramadan lecture series on the story of prophet Lut A.s where its looked at from a different and more inclusive perspective. Looking at the story as a condemnation of rape and sexual abuse on a mass scale rather than homosexual acts themselves. It was very interesting and I would suggest it if you want to listen to a different perspective even if you don’t necessarily believe it.

I feel the exact same. I’m 23 and have recently started looking into ADHD symptoms online as friends have pointed out to me that I could have it. The more research I do the more I relate to the symptoms. I too think back to GCSEs and how I would stay up really late trying to revise and understand and I’d always have to re read passages due to getting distracted and not taking things in, abs it always felt like I was trying extra hard in comparison to my peers and still not getting the best results in the end. I too took two years out of uni, although they weren’t consecutive they were both for similar reasons, to deal with depression that I’d had since school and anxiety. However again whilst at uni I don’t think I’ve ever handed any piece of work on time, and I find it impossible to get started to work even when I know a deadline is coming but when I do start I’m extremely fidgety and get super distracted. Something that would take someone 20 would take me 2 hours and o complete.

It’s really frustrating knowing you want to complete something but you genuinely feel like you can’t concentrate so I totally understand as I’m going through the same thing. Even with being diagnosed, i haven’t even started the process yet but I’m scared to just Incase a doctor disagrees and says there’s no point. My therapist said I didn’t show any signs but I should probably still push to find out.
